notes: Expected 400/401/503 statuses are successful negative checks, not unexpected failures.
Other development builds and package checks overlapped this soak; this is not an isolated throughput benchmark.
Swap observation began partway through the run; RSS decreases cannot be interpreted alone as memory savings.
The current source harness adds VmSwap fields; this run preserves the earlier executed harness hash and separate swap observations.
A passing protocol/drain test and stable sampled memory do not prove absence of all leaks.

process_cleanup.scope: Only own Popen server child was terminated; no pkill/killall/process-group termination.
